# Oceanis

> Official Oceanis web application by Armin Lišić, published as part of Codarox.

Canonical URL: https://oceanis.codarox.com/
Codarox: https://codarox.com/
GitHub repository: https://github.com/Armin-000/realtime-weather-waves

## What Oceanis is

Oceanis is a cinematic real-time 3D ocean and atmosphere simulation built with Three.js, TypeScript and WebGL. It transforms live weather and marine conditions into an interactive environmental visualization.

## Live data used

Oceanis uses Open-Meteo services for weather, marine and geocoding data. The application responds to wind speed and direction, wave height and period, precipitation, cloud cover, sunrise, sunset and other environmental conditions.

## Main capabilities

- Real-time weather-driven 3D ocean visualization
- Marine wave and swell data visualization
- Dynamic day, sunset, sunrise and night atmosphere
- Rain and storm effects
- Location search
- Interactive Three.js camera and environment

Oceanis is developed by Armin Lišić. Codarox is the public software engineering portfolio and brand associated with the project.
